rawContent: If @hackneycouncil is fighting so radically against #ClimateChange, how could they let the @WoodlandTrust 2020 Happy Man Tree of the Year get cut down to make way for new build flats in #WoodburyDowns this morning?! Are the new build flats “affordable” too?! #hypocrisy
.@Sistah_Space WE are here for you. WE believe you. WE see you. Know that WE are behind you. #SaveSistahSpace #BLM #EndVAWG

On one hand it is good news @hackneycouncil accepted the 2nd petition @Sistah_Space submitted for debate at the next council meeting on the 27th. But, it still has not fulfilled the Public Sector Equality Duty by providing a #SafeSpaceForSistahSpace #SaveSistahSpace #BLM
